en.summary: The commit fixes L1 tag-way selection and dirty-bit targeting so write hits and flushes update the correct cache way.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says a dirty-write bug is fixed.
The changed DUT file is a core L1 cache metadata module.
The patch corrects waymask ordering and dirty-bit indexing, which directly affect cache correctness.
disqualifiers: The commit also adds build helper, IDE files, and a testcase file.
Only one DUT source file carries the hardware fix.
evidence: `L1TagAccess.scala` changes dirty-bit clearing on flush from indexing with a raw one-hot vector to `OHToUInt(...)`.
A new DCache test name and testcase text are added alongside the RTL fix, indicating a concrete failing cache scenario.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A set-associative cache must update dirty metadata for the exact way that hit or was chosen for flush or invalidate. This commit fixes two representation mismatches: the hit waymask bit ordering was reversed relative to the metadata arrays, and the flush path used a one-hot way vector as if it were already a numeric way index. Either mistake can mark or clear the wrong way's dirty bit while tag compare and data array accesses otherwise appear normal.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: tag-hit way selection and dirty-bit targeting
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A write hit sets the dirty bit, or a flush or invalidate operation clears the dirty bit for a chosen way.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Misalign the hit waymask bit ordering or use one-hot way selection as an index when writing dirty metadata.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reverse waymask bit order and or skip one-hot-to-index conversion
portability_notes: Apply this to metadata update paths only; the data array can remain correct.
If the cache stores dirty bits in a vector indexed by way number, corrupt that mapping rather than the replacement policy.
Either the hit path or the flush path can be mutated independently; both together more closely match the original defect.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that converts tag-compare results into a one-hot hit-way signal.
Reverse the bit ordering or otherwise map the hit result to the wrong way position before updating dirty state.
In the flush or invalidate path, use the raw one-hot selected-way bits as an index or choose the wrong way number when clearing dirty.
Leave replacement and tag-compare functionality intact so failures appear as wrong dirty bookkeeping.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1 tag checker waymask generation and dirty-bit update path
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes Reverse from the hit waymask construction and converts the flush-selected one-hot way bits with OHToUInt before clearing way_dirty.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore Reverse(Cat(...)) in tagChecker.io.waymask and replace OHToUInt(flush-way) with the raw one-hot expression in the flush dirty-bit update.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The cache sets or clears the dirty bit for the wrong way, leading to stale dirty metadata, missed writebacks, or incorrect victim handling.
evidence_for_injection: The patch fixes both the hit-path way ordering and the flush-path one-hot indexing.
Only metadata bookkeeping logic is changed; the data array path is untouched.
The companion testcase text names an access pattern that would expose wrong dirty-way updates.
notes: Reverting either of the two fixes can reintroduce the bug; reverting both best matches the original failure.
The source-level mutation is local to metadata handling and does not require altering replacement or tag storage structures.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L1 tag way 选择和 dirty 位定位问题，使写命中和 flush 能更新正确的 cache way。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复了 dirty-write 相关 bug。
被修改的 DUT 文件是核心 L1 cache 元数据模块。
补丁修正了 `waymask` 顺序和 dirty 位索引方式，会直接影响 cache 正确性。
disqualifiers: 该提交还加入了构建辅助脚本、IDE 文件和 testcase 文件。
真正的硬件修复只集中在一个 DUT 源文件里。
evidence: `L1TagAccess.scala` 在 flush 清除 dirty 位时，不再直接用原始 one-hot 向量索引，而是改为 `OHToUInt(...)`。
`L1TagAccess.scala` 生成 tag-hit `waymask` 时去掉了 `Reverse(...)`。
提交同时加入了新的 DCache 测试名和 testcase 文本，表明存在具体的 cache 失败场景。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 组相联 cache 必须把 dirty 元数据更新到真正命中的 way，或 flush/invalidate 选中的那个 way。该提交修复了两个表示层面的不一致：hit waymask 的位顺序与元数据数组的索引顺序相反，flush 路径又把 one-hot 选中的 way 向量当成了数值索引。即便 tag compare 和 data array 本身仍然正常，这两类错误也会把错误 way 的 dirty 位设脏或清零。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: tag-hit way 选择与 dirty 位目标定位
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: write hit 需要置 dirty，或者 flush/invalidate 需要清除某个选中 way 的 dirty 位。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 hit waymask 的位顺序与真实 way 编号错位，或者把 one-hot 方式选中的 way 直接当作索引来写 dirty 元数据。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 反转 waymask 位序，和/或跳过 one-hot 到索引的转换
portability_notes: 故障应注入到元数据更新路径，而不是数据阵列本身。
如果 cache 用按 way 编号索引的 dirty 向量存储元数据，应破坏这个映射关系，而不是替换策略。
只回退 hit 路径或 flush 路径中的任意一处都能形成故障；两处同时回退更接近原始错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把 tag compare 结果转换成 one-hot hit-way 信号的逻辑。
在更新 dirty 状态前，把该 hit 结果反序或映射到错误的 way 位置。
在 flush/invalidate 路径中，把 one-hot 选中的 way 直接当作索引，或故意选择错误的 way 编号来清 dirty。
保持替换策略和 tag 比较逻辑不变，使故障表现为 dirty 记账错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1 tag checker 的 waymask 生成与 dirty 位更新路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 补丁去掉了 hit waymask 构造中的 Reverse，并在清除 way_dirty 前用 OHToUInt 把 flush 选中的 one-hot way 转成索引。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 tagChecker.io.waymask 中恢复 Reverse(Cat(...))，并在 flush 清 dirty 的逻辑中把 OHToUInt(flush-way) 改回原始 one-hot 表达式。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: cache 会在错误的 way 上设置或清除 dirty 位，导致 dirty 元数据陈旧、写回丢失，或 victim 处理错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁同时修复了 hit 路径的 way 顺序和 flush 路径的 one-hot 索引问题。
修改只发生在元数据记账逻辑，数据阵列路径没有变化。
配套 testcase 文本命名了能暴露 dirty-way 更新错误的访问模式。
notes: 回退这两处修复中的任意一处都可能重新引入 bug；两处同时回退最接近原始失效模式。
源级变异局限在元数据处理路径，不需要改动替换策略或 tag 存储结构。
